QuestInfo.name: Harmonia's first story
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2081100##k said she'll tell me the first truth and told me to come talk to her again when I'm ready.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2081100##k told me about Zakum, which is the first truth.  She said come back to her when I'm ready to hear the second truth.

0.0: The first story is about the town that vanished within a lava volcano. Would you like to listen?

yes.0: Good. You should listen to the story. Talk to me when you're ready.

no.0: Are you afraid? You've come this far...

1.0: Have you ever been to the deep lava volcano in the El Nath mountains? There used to be a town there.
1.1: People in the town worshipped a human shaped stone statue and the volcano. They built an altar and stone statue under the tree at the basin of the deepest volcano and worshiped the altar to prove their faith.
1.2: Then disaster struck. It was the wicked Zakum's tree. Zakum's spirit didn't have a body but instead possessed the stone statue that people built. His evil rapidly spread through the town...
1.3: After that, the town disappeared. You've heard about the fearsome power called #bZakum#k sleeping under the lava volcano, as you've traveled the Maple World for a long time.'Now you know how he came to be. You can guess what happened to the townspeople...

yes.0: That's the end of the first story. Talk to me when you're ready to listen to the second story.
